channel.title: Standard Mobile Company Market Insights
channel.description: Research on IT asset disposition, refurbished electronics, and the secondary hardware market.

item.title: Why Three-Year Lease Returns Set the Wholesale Price for Business Laptops
item.description: Corporate three-year lease returns flood the secondary market in predictable waves. Residual values, config mix, and return timing set wholesale bids for ThinkPads, Latitudes, and EliteBooks.

item.title: How Apple Silicon Macs Actually Depreciate, From M1 Through Later Chips
item.description: Apple silicon Macs do not depreciate like Intel Macs. Chip generation, unified-memory config, and macOS support length set wholesale bids from M1 through later M-series machines.

item.title: What Windows 10 End of Support Did to the Corporate PC Secondary Market
item.description: Microsoft ended Windows 10 support on October 14, 2025. That deadline flooded ITAD channels with business laptops, split the wholesale market by Windows 11 readiness, and reset prices for fleets that cannot upgrade.
